cards.back: Call them as soon as you arrive!

cards.back: I hate calling head office for help. Tell him to call them!

cards.back: His name's Jack, but everyone calls him by his nickname, 'Jay'.

cards.back: But calling people by their nicknames is fine.

cards.back: I can't give the information over the phone, I'll email you.
